import { type JSXChildren, type QRL } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface TabItem {
    value: string;
    label: JSXChildren;
    content: JSXChildren;
    disabled?: boolean;
    id?: string;
}
export interface TabsProps {
    id?: string;
    items: readonly TabItem[];
    label?: JSXChildren;
    'aria-label'?: string;
    'aria-labelledby'?: string;
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    onValueChange$?: QRL<(detail: ValueChangeDetails<string>) => void>;
    activationMode?: 'manual' | 'automatic';
    orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
}
export declare const Tabs: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<TabsProps>;
